assumptions.execution: Signals at close; market orders at the next available daily open. Whole shares; equal maximum allocation per symbol; no leverage or shorting.
assumptions.positions: Open positions are marked at the last close, not forcibly liquidated. Win rate uses closed trades only.
assumptions.costs: Fees and slippage apply on both entries and exits. Taxes, market impact, liquidity constraints and corporate actions are not modelled.
assumptions.evaluation: Rule selection uses development validation only. Repeated manual inspection makes later-period results exploratory.
assumptions.annualization: 252 sessions per year; Sharpe uses zero risk-free rate; no significance claim.
